calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_end),
active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE f.sale_date > p.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.as_of_end
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT a.member_id, cur.tier, cur.join_date
    FROM active a CROSS JOIN params p
    LEFT JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id
         AND p.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
)
SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS n_distinct, SUM(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2025-12-21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_after
FROM tiered GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier

calls.statement:
SELECT
 COUNT(*) AS lines,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_key IS NULL) AS orphan_lines,
 COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_key) FILTER (WHERE m.member_key IS NULL) AS orphan_keys,
 MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_d, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_d,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-12-31') AS after_cutoff,
 COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dup_line_ids
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
